question.text: Under the SEBI (AIF) (Second Amendment) Regulations, 2025 co-investment framework, Angel Funds specifically:

answer.text: Must launch a CIV scheme for every investment exceeding INR 5 crore
Shall not launch any CIV schemes
May only launch CIV schemes for listed equity investments
Are exempt from shelf placement memorandum filing

explanation.text: The Logic: Per Series XIX-C page 312, a separate Co-Investment Vehicle (CIV) scheme shall be launched for each co-investment in an investee company, but Angel Funds shall not launch any CIV schemes. The Angel Fund carve-out is explicit in the 2025 framework. The Trap: The Rs. 5 crore threshold, the listed-equity-only restriction, and the shelf placement memorandum exemption are not what page 312 says about Angel Funds. The rule is a blanket no-CIV carve-out for Angel Funds. Note: Anchor the answer on the Angel Fund carve-out from the CIV scheme framework on pages 311-312.
